event-cleanup.name: Event Cleanup & Setup
event-cleanup.title: Event Cleanup & Setup Services
event-cleanup.metaDescription: Event setup and cleanup for weddings, parties, quinceañeras and Bar and Bat Mitzvahs, plus housekeeping, from Linda D. Ray: over 25 years of hands-on experience.
event-cleanup.lead: You plan the celebration. We handle the work around it: tables set before guests arrive, and the room left clean after they go.
whatWeDo: Service With A Smile sets up and cleans up family events: weddings, birthday and anniversary parties, reunions, quinceañeras, and Bar and Bat Mitzvahs. We also keep homes in order with regular housekeeping and in-home support.
Owner Linda D. Ray has done this work for more than 25 years. She plans each job with you herself and is there to make sure it gets done the way you agreed.

whoWeHelp.p: Backyard parties and holiday gatherings, where the cleanup lands on whoever is hosting.
Weddings and receptions where the venue expects the room back clean by a set time.
Quinceañeras and Bar and Bat Mitzvahs, where the family would rather be with their guests than in the kitchen.

whoWeHelp.h: People who need a hand at home
whoWeHelp.p: Seniors, busy parents and anyone recovering or short on time who wants the house kept up.

whyTrusted: More than 25 years doing this work
Owner-led: you deal with Linda from the first call to the last walkthrough
Based in Oak Park, Sacramento, and knows local homes and halls
Straight answers on what's included, with no pressure to book
